SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I| Rezoning Attachment
2733-35 West 16th Street / 1600-12 South Fairfield Avenue
From RT-4 RM-5

The Property

The subject property is a vacant parcel located in a RT-4, Residential Two-Plat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District on the
southwest corner of West 16" Street and South Fairfield Avenue. It js located in a Transit Served Location approximately
1,670 feet from the California Pink Line CTA station entrance.

The Project
TM 2735 PARTNERS LLC (the “Applicant”) seeks to rezone the property to construct a new three-story residential

building (approximately 39’-10” height) with six residential units, three rear surface parking spaces, and six bicycle spaces.

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District toa RM-
5, Residential Multi-Unit District.

The Applicant also is seeking all relief as needed for the attached plans, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a
Type-I application under section 17-13-0300(D) including: 1) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce
the required front yard setback under section 17-2-0305-B to 3’-9”; 2) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to
reduce the west side yard setback required under sections 17-2-0309-A and 17-17-0309 from minimum 2.0" to zero (there
will be bicycle parking placed along that side setback); 3) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the
required combined side yard setback under section 17-2-0309-A from 5.0’ to zero; 4) an optional variation under section 17-
13-1101-B to reduce the rear yard setback under section 17-2-0306-C from 40.5” to 23’-7" ; and 5) an optional variation
under sections 17-13-1003-K and 17-13-1101-A to reduce the rear yard open space required under section 1 7-2-0307 to zero.
Section 17-10-0102-B (1)(a) authorizes a 100% parking reduction for properties located in a TSL district to a CTA station
entrance. The Applicant is opting to provide three parking spaces.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 3,375 square feet

FAR: 2.0

Floor Area: 6,741 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 6

MLA Density: 562.5 square feet

Height: 39-10”

Automobile Parking: 3

Bicycle Parking: 6

Rear Yard Open Space: zero*

Setbacks: Front (North/ 16" St): 37-9" *
East (Fairfield Ave): zero (none required)
West: zero*
Rear (South): 23°-7" *

A set of plans is attached.
* The Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
